review.note: Catalogue corrected from Ardea ibis to Eastern cattle egret Ardea coromanda without changing the cattle-egret ID or backup schema. Commons explicitly identifies this file as Ardea coromanda in Bhagalpur, Bihar, India, photographed on 21 December 2025 by Tisha Mukherjee (own work, CC BY-SA 4.0). Exact article P225 is Ardea coromanda. NZBO uses the older Bubulcus ibis coromandus treatment for the eastern form occurring in Australia and New Zealand. Thumbnail inspected for composition: a single live bird on grass, no livestock; reject the goat-dominated Wikipedia lead. Taxonomic identity relies on the file-specific description and locality, not an independent visual identification or a claim that the photograph was taken in NZ.
